errors.evidence: The description reports the values for A-DBSCAN, Random, and K-Center-Greedy in the AVG category as 68, 67, and 68, respectively. This incorrectly states that the A-DBSCAN bar (purple) is the same height as the K-Center-Greedy bar (green). The image clearly shows that the K-Center-Greedy bar is the tallest of the three, while the A-DBSCAN bar is slightly shorter.
